messages.subject: Modification Indicies for Scalar noninvariance
parts:
Hey there!

I am new to this so apologies if I am missing something obvious. 

Following CFAs I have conducted measurement invariance tests looking at invariance across 3 countries. Configural and Metric were fine however the Scalar invariance test was noninvariant, so we want to establish partial invariance by looking at the modification indices and freeing some constraints.  

When I ran  LavTestScore(Model1, epc = TRUE ) it provided the univariate score tests, however it only appears to show the intercepts for:
  •  group 1 with group 2
  •  group 1 with group 3 
I wondered if anyone could advise me on why it does not appear to compare group 2 and group 3?

Hope this makes sense and thanks in advance. 

Jess

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Modification Indicies for Scalar noninvariance
parts:
it only appears to show the intercepts for:
  •  group 1 with group 2
  •  group 1 with group 3 
I wondered if anyone could advise me on why it does not appear to compare group 2 and group 3?

Because that constraint is implied by other 2.  If g2 and g3 are both equal to g1, they must be equal to each other.  My advice is to avoid testing pairwise comparisons between multiple groups.  Too many problems with sampling error and bias introduced by invalid constraints when testing valid ones.  Just test whether each indicator is invariant across all groups.   In lavTestScore(), you can do this one item at a time by passing the vector of those constraint numbers, so  the multivariate $test statistic will be for the omnibus H0 for that indicator.
